mainEntity.name: What is a shadow report book?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shadow report book is a second, private log alongside the official training record. The official report book is signed by your training company, so overtime, non-training tasks or uncomfortable incidents rarely make it in. In the shadow report book you record exactly those things with a date, encrypted and for your eyes only.

mainEntity.name: Does the shadow report book replace my official one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The training record under § 13 of the German Vocational Training Act stays mandatory and is still signed off by your company. The shadow report book runs alongside it as a private record.

mainEntity.name: What do I need the entries for later?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a dated memory aid when you want to sort something out — with your trainer, the works council for young employees, the chamber of commerce or an advice centre. Anyone recounting events months later usually has only a rough recollection. A dated note is more concrete.

Every entry is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key is derived from your password via PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations and never leaves your device. There is no server, no account and no cloud copy — and therefore no recovery if you forget the password.

mainEntity.name: Can my training company see the entries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not through MyWorkLog. The data sits encrypted in your own browser storage and is never transmitted anywhere. Without access to your unlocked device and your password, nobody sees anything.

mainEntity.name: What does the shadow report book cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing. It is part of MyWorkLog: free, ad-free and usable without an account.

driveModal.google_bekommt_eine_verschlue: Google receives an encrypted file — nothing more.
driveModal.hochgeladen_wird_derselbe_blo: What gets uploaded is the same block that “Export backup” produces: encrypted with your vault password. Without that password the file in Drive is unreadable, for Google and for us alike. The app only ever gets access to files it creates itself — the rest of your Drive stays invisible to it.
driveSetup.fuer_die_verbindung_braucht_d: To connect, this page needs an OAuth client ID from the Google Cloud Console: create a project, then APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID for a web application. As the authorised JavaScript origin, enter:
driveSetup.die_clientid_ist_kein_geheimn: The client ID is not a secret — it appears in plain text on every Google sign-in and may live in the source code.
driveConnect.google_fragt_dich_einmal_um: Google asks for your permission once. After that the backup sits in your own Drive, in the folder “MyWorkLog Schatten-Berichtsheft”.
journalModal.jeder_angelegte_geaenderte_: Every entry you create, change or delete carries the fingerprint of the one before it. If something is altered, removed or slipped in afterwards, the chain stops matching from that point on — and you see it below.
journalModal.sie_ersetzt_keine_beglaubig: It is not a certification. Anyone with your vault password can recompute the whole chain, and your device clock is freely adjustable. The proof only carries weight once you get the chain head out of the house early: email it to your works council, photograph it, show it to someone you trust. From that moment on, what your record looked like back then is settled.
driveSetup.genau_so_ohne_schraegstrich_a: Exactly like that, with no trailing slash, and into the “Authorised JavaScript origins” field — not “Authorised redirect URIs”. If you also open the page from somewhere else, each address needs its own entry. If the value does not match, Google reports “Error 400: origin_mismatch”.
